name: CL Educate Ltd
title: CL Educate Ltd - 540403 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Group revenue up 55% to ₹570 cr, but the gain is DEXIT acquisition-led; L&D revenue fell ~11% on 12–14% realisation drop and is guided flat for four more quarters, with ₹180 cr acquisition debt still outstanding.

triggers.label: L&D realisation down 12–14%
triggers.quote: the average realization saw a dramatic downward movement of about 12 to 14%, which resulted in our overall revenue declining by about 11%
triggers.highlight: average realization saw a dramatic downward movement of about 12 to 14%

triggers.label: Assessments order book ~80–85% of FY26 revenue
triggers.quote: the order book for FY27 for the Assessments business is almost close to 80 to 85% of the entire revenue we achieved in the full year of FY26
triggers.highlight: order book for FY27 for the Assessments business is almost close to 80 to 85%

triggers.label: L&D revenue flat for ~4 quarters
triggers.quote: While revenues may stay flat for another four quarters before they begin to see an uptick
triggers.highlight: revenues may stay flat for another four quarters

triggers.label: New entrants in assessments
triggers.quote: There are new entrants in the assessment space as we speak
triggers.highlight: There are new entrants in the assessment space

guidance.quote: the L&D segment is expected to more or less remain flat

guidance.value: healthy growth, order book 80-85% of FY26 revenue
guidance.quote: We should be able to show reasonably healthy revenue growth in this line of business
we will definitely see the needle beginning to show a positive upward movement from Q1 itself

red_flags.label: Acquisition debt and PAT drag
red_flags.quote: our interest and depreciation charge grew to ₹ 85 crores from the previous year's figure of ₹ 29 crore

red_flags.label: Cash largely NSE-owned, pending NCLT
red_flags.quote: there are approximately ₹ 193 to 194 crores of the cash that you see on our balance sheet which belongs to NSE

red_flags.label: Fundraising on pause
red_flags.quote: we are on a slight pause given the overall environment

red_flags.label: Order-to-revenue timing slippage
red_flags.quote: those orders rolled over — they were initially expected in Q4 of last year but rolled into Q1 and Q2 of this year

evasions.quote: This is a nuanced question because whether it is government or private, there is not a significant difference in the prices
we are on a slight pause given the overall environment, as you all know
